control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the line tracker reads less than 70 %, drive forward at 40 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line; where there is no line (a dark tunnel) drive straight without touching the walls; then follow the line again.

decision_points.condition: the line tracker brightness is below 70 % (the black line)

branches.outcome: below 70 % (on the black line): drive forward at 40 %
70 % or more (no black line): call stopAtWall

decision_points.condition: an obstacle is ahead (front obstacle sensor)

branches.reason: followLine runs only when the line tracker reads 70 % or more, so it never sees black there; this branch can't happen.

uncertainties: Your program reads the line tracker, not the light: it can't tell it is in a dark tunnel, so 'no line' behaves the same as anywhere without a line.
Your program drives straight only when it sees the black line (below 70 %); with no line it curves right, so 'drive straight where there is no line' won't hold.
The 'curve left when it sees black' branch can't happen: followLine runs only when the line is 70 % or more, so it never sees black there.
Following the line again after the tunnel can't be tested apart from following the line: your program doesn't sense the tunnel.
On the black line it drives straight without steering, so it follows only a straight line, not a bend.
You didn't say what the robot should do at a wall in the light.
